Thanks for the quick intake call earlier. We're ready to kick off vendor activation for PropelTech (vendor ID: PT-8821). Procurement has asked that we align on the PO routing and payment cadence before we flip the supplier to "active."

High-level from our side: procurement prefers Net60, but AP is open to Net45 if the remittance lane can be consolidated to a single invoice delivery path (email to ap@propeltech.com or via their portal). They also asked whether Redwood offers an early-pay program (discount for 7/15-day payment) — they may be interested if the enrollment process is straightforward.

I've attached the completed vendor form and our W-9. Can you confirm:
- Which PO header fields Redwood requires to ensure automated PO/invoice matching
- Best path to enroll in early-pay (if available) and sample terms

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Hi Clara — thanks for the docs and clear summary. Looping in Karthik from our vendor-ops/PO mapping team to handle the technical side.

Quick answers up front:
- PO header fields: we require PO number (URN), line-level SKU or description, remit-to code (we can accept a single remit-to for PropelTech), and the invoice total. For automated matching use: "PO/URN" in the invoice subject and the line-level amounts must sum to the invoice total.
- Payment cadence options: we typically support Net30/Net45/Net60. For Net45 we can activate immediately if your AP confirms a single delivery path.
- Early-pay: we offer an Accelerated Remit program (optional) — typical structure: 1.5% discount for payment within 7 days, or 1% for 15 days. Enrollment requires a signed addendum; terms attached.

Karthik — can you confirm the PO activation lead time if we consolidate to email-only invoicing (ap@propeltech.com), and whether we need a sample/test invoice?

I attached our Accelerated Remit T&Cs for reference.

Attachment: accelerated_remit_terms.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,

Hi Clara — quick operational notes from vendor-ops:

1) Enrollment for Accelerated Remit is handled on our side once we receive the signed Vendor Addendum (I attached a DocuSign link in this thread). No special bank/account refs are required on your end; simply ensure invoices reference the PO/URN and the vendor remit code. Redwood applies the early-pay discount at settlement and issues the net payment to your primary remit account.

2) Invoice cut-off windows:
- For Net60/Net45 customers we have two daily invoice intake batches (10:00 UTC and 22:00 UTC) for matching and routing.
- If you need same-day processing for early-pay enrollment, please submit invoices to ap@propeltech.com before 10:00 UTC to be included in the day's earliest batch.

3) Test invoice path: please send a test invoice (subject: TEST INVOICE — PT-8821 — PO: TBD) to ap@propeltech.com and cc: olga.petrov@redwood.com. Karthik/vendor-ops will confirm matching and that the URN resolves to the correct cost center.

4) PO activation lead time: once we have the signed vendor addendum and your confirmed remit-to, we can activate PO matching within 3 business days. If you want to pilot early-pay on a single cost center, we can enable that at activation and monitor the first two invoice cycles.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/XYZ-PropelTech-Vendor-Addendum

Attachment: vendor_addendum_docusign.pdf (link/stub)

Let me know if you'd like a quick 15-min call tomorrow to walk through the test invoice.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Vendor Operations — Redwood Inference

3) Once DocuSign & remit account confirmed, Redwood to activate PO matching within 3 business days and opt-in PropelTech to Accelerated Remit for a single cost center pilot.
4) Karthik will send a short checklist for invoice header requirements and confirm the batch time we'll use for the pilot.

If that matches, I'll schedule a 15-min checkpoint for 11/02 to review the first invoice results. Clara — if the test invoice hits before 10/00 UTC on 10/28 we should be able to keep to that timeline.
